# Sensitive paths: a pull request that touches one of them needs the owner's approval (Review gate, scripts/review-gate.py).
# One shell-style pattern per line (fnmatch: `*` also matches `/`); lines starting with # are comments. The gate reads this
# file from the BASE branch, so a pull request cannot edit it to escape the rule. The owner's own pull requests pass.
# Everything else is reviewed as the team agrees (ADR-0008), without waiting for the owner.

# Delivery, gates and harness
.github/*
scripts/*
mk/*

deploy/*
*Dockerfile*

# Data and contract
db/migrations/*
api/openapi.yaml

# Platform code every module depends on
src/api/internal/platform/*

# Secrets, dependencies and CADEV records
secrets/*
.npmrc
*/.npmrc
go.mod
go.sum
package.json
src/web/package.json
pnpm-lock.yaml
THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
